question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The new Vande Bharat trains will have some additional ________ such as emergency windows for evacuation, disaster lights etc.
solution:
The correct answer is **'features'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **qualities - **the standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.(गुण, विशेषताएँ, स्वभाव)
 
• **features - **a distinctive attribute or aspect of something.(विशेषताएँ, लक्षण)
 
• **pieces - **a portion of an object or of material, produced by cutting, tearing, or breaking the whole.(टुकड़े)
 
• **types - **a category of people or things having common characteristics.(प्रकार, क़िस्म)
 
 
 
• From the given sentence, we can conclude that the given blank needs a word that would point out the 'additional' properties of the mentioned trains. 
 
• So, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank based on the above meanings is **features. **
 
• Thus,**option 2 **is the correct answer.
